summary_short.zh: Front-End-Checklist 是一个详尽的前端开发检查清单，帮助开发者系统性地验证现代网站的所有关键环节，避免生产环境中的常见疏漏。它通过将性能、安全、可访问性等复杂质量要求分解为结构化检查点，使质量保证过程变得清晰可控。开发者可在项目上线前将其作为审计工具集成到工作流中，根据具体需求定制检查项，或作为学习资源掌握行业最佳实践，从而构建更稳定、高效的Web应用。

summaries.en: Front-End-Checklist is a comprehensive guide that helps developers systematically verify all critical aspects of modern web projects, preventing common oversights in production deployments. It organizes validation criteria into logical categories like performance, security, and accessibility, making complex quality assurance manageable through structured checkpoints. Developers can integrate it into their workflow as a pre-launch audit tool, customize it for specific project needs, or use it as an educational resource to learn industry best practices for robust web development.
